result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers give concrete screen layouts with a prominent search field, grouped suggestions while typing, cross-area matches for branches and events, and helpful zero-result handling. A is more explicit about what the app remembers (home branch, pickup branch, query, filters, scroll position, offline data) and puts a Renew button on each checkout. B's Home dashboard is strong, but its Home and Search tabs partly duplicate each other and it never spells out renewal. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers make search prominent and handle typing and zero results well. B is stronger on the library's real tasks: it puts a Renew button on each checkout, places a hold in one tap using the remembered pickup branch, and lets people use public features without signing in. It also remembers more, including recent searches, scroll position, filters, pickup branch and offline data. A gives a clearer reason for its tab choices (merging Holds and Checkouts) but never makes renewing an explicit one-tap action.
